subgroup_lemma.statement: A connected reductive H subset GL4 over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, of rank 4 and with scalar commutant, equals GL4.
subgroup_lemma.proof_key: Schur gives center rank <=1; derived rank >=3; the only faithful irreducible four-dimensional semisimple type of rank >=3 is A3; rank 4 adds the scalar center.
